unit.why: A single anecdote: R. Moshe Leib of Sasov meets the author of Degel Mahaneh Ephraim on the road, and in a forest his shout miraculously gathers a tenth man for the afternoon prayer.
unit.boundary_note: division ends mid-sentence ('כמו כי'); the end of the story appears truncated, and the next division begins a new numbered story (מו)

stories.start_quote: אמר אשר שלשה עשר שנים רצופים
stories.end_quote: הי' לי שאגת ארי׳ כמו כי
stories.summary_en: R. Moshe Leib, longing to see the Degel Mahaneh Ephraim of Sudylkow, who was travelling to the doctors in Lviv, meets him on the road and travels with him; in a forest at the time of the afternoon prayer, with only nine men, he cries out 'come to the synagogue', and a man far away hears it and comes to complete the minyan, and R. Moshe Leib explains that his voice then was like a lion's roar.
